:::{#thm-mutual-information-symmetric}
#### Mutual information is symmetric

For discrete random variables $X$ and $Y$ with finite entropies,

$$I(X; Y) = H(X) - H(X \mid Y) = I(Y; X).$$

:::

::: {.proof}

The [chain rule](#thm-entropy-chain-rule) expands $H(X, Y)$ in either order:

$$H(X) + H(Y \mid X) = H(X, Y) = H(Y) + H(X \mid Y).$$

Subtracting $H(X \mid Y) + H(Y \mid X)$ from the outer two expressions gives

$$H(X) - H(X \mid Y) = H(Y) - H(Y \mid X).$$

The right side is $I(X; Y)$ by @def-mutual-information,
and the left side is $I(Y; X)$ by the same definition.

:::
